governed_league_universe: Selected-50 governed season manifest; exact selected_id mapping only
history_cutoff_rule: Only completed, valid-score historical matches strictly earlier than the runtime fixture kickoff UTC; never lower the five-match runtime feature minimum.
h2h_matching_policy: Exact Selected-50 country scope; exact normalized unordered team names preferred, exact provider team IDs fallback; completed valid-score meetings strictly before cutoff; no fuzzy aliases or cross-country joins; zero means no verified pair in pinned archive, not proof of no prior meetings.
xg_policy: Quarantine xG from prediction/backtest/betting unless fixture-linked capture timestamp and immutable revision/hash evidence prove point-in-time availability before kickoff.
production_and_betting_policy: Research/report-only. production_eligible=false and betting_eligible=false. Do not modify Oracle V1.6 model logic or probabilities.
weekly_run_instructions: From the governed research branch, manually dispatch the report workflow after a successful Selected-50 runtime run. Set confirm_private_archive_read=true, retain the pinned archive tag, and provide the current successful runtime_run_id (no stale default is supplied). The report makes zero FootyStats results API calls by default and writes an explicit NOT_RETRIEVED_NO_CREDIT_APPROVAL Actual Results register. Set confirm_results_provider_credit_usage=true only after explicit bounded approval and verified credit budget; then FOOTYSTATS_API_KEY is required and actual results are fetched. All report outputs remain research-only.
required_inputs: confirm_private_archive_read=true; private_archive_release_tag=research-selected50-footystats-history-40375285207; runtime_run_id=<current successful governed Selected-50 runtime run>
reproducibility_rule: All report-generation scripts, tests, workflow, selected-season manifest and this configuration are version-controlled in oracle-validation-learning. Reuse the workflow; do not recreate workbook manually. Update config only through reviewed commits.

results_provider.matching_policy: Exact provider season ID + fixture ID + ordered home and away provider team IDs; no fuzzy fallback
results_provider.settlement_policy: Only completed status and valid non-negative integer final scores; all ambiguous or unavailable records remain unresolved
results_provider.eligibility: Opt-in only: confirm_results_provider_credit_usage=true is required before any results API call. Default false produces a zero-call NOT_RETRIEVED_NO_CREDIT_APPROVAL register. production_eligible=false; betting_eligible=false; prediction_probabilities_modified=false.
results_provider.credit_control: Separate explicit workflow_dispatch boolean approval required; provider API calls are zero unless confirm_results_provider_credit_usage=true.
